review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial review (fresh general-purpose agent, packet renderer cohort, 2026-11-14, task a5c4e116b2dbc1841)
review.note: APPROVE with zero MAJOR. The reviewer independently reproduced the 4/2/0 partition, ported the position/range and field validators to a simulator against a separate spec oracle, and ran 58 named attack vectors, 103 boundary cases and 900,000 fuzzed/mutation/random-byte inputs with zero accept/reject divergence, crash or non-verbatim emission. Every malformed position (non-numeric, signed, empty range side, extra dash, internal space), unquoted/empty/embedded-quote label and trailing token fails closed; C0/DEL/non-ASCII literals fail closed and punctuation inside a quoted label stays data. The family's only non-ASCII bytes are em-dashes inside the frontmatter descriptions of the two complex fixtures (one clean, one gated); every body is pure ASCII. The trim-before-colon frontmatter gate and the printable-ASCII literal hardening are confirmed. The NITs (a reconstructed header line keeps a CRLF carriage return that ftxui discards invisibly and which matches the approved railroad sibling, the over-broad ':::' substring gate, and accepting reversed/leading-zero ranges as shape-only, non-integer-parsing inputs) are fail-safe or faithful with no corpus sample and are unchanged per the blast-radius rule.
